instruction: Duplicate the Mount Hua photo in my Pictures directory with the name 'picture3_backup.jpg'.

result.command: python3 -c "from PIL import Image; import hashlib; import os; path1='/home/user/Pictures/picture3.jpg'; path2='/home/user/Pictures/picture3_backup.jpg'; h1=hashlib.sha256(Image.open(path1).tobytes()).hexdigest() if os.path.exists(path1) else 'NONE'; h2=hashlib.sha256(Image.open(path2).tobytes()).hexdigest() if os.path.exists(path2) else 'NONE'; print(f'{h1}|{h2}')"
